title: NTSB investigation: Lake Erie vessel collision
summary: The completed investigation describes an August 10, 2024 collision on Lake Erie between a NOAA Great Lakes Environmental Research Laboratory uncrewed surface vessel and a recreational vessel. NTSB found inadequate perceptibility and passive monitoring left the uncrewed vessel without a proper lookout; it issued six safety recommendations.
review_question: Can a handoff preserve the investigation’s operating conditions, finding, and recommendations without compressing one into the other?

title: SEC enforcement complaint describes use of public filings
summary: The SEC announced charges against BG Wealth Sharing Ltd and DSJ Exchange Pty Ltd. Its complaint alleges the entities used SEC Form ADV and Form D filings to create an impression of legitimacy while raising more than $130 million from tens of thousands of retail investors. These are allegations in a filed complaint, not adjudicated findings.
review_question: Does a summary distinguish what the agency announced, what the complaint alleges, and what a court has decided?

title: Isaias event summary: observations and ongoing assessment
summary: The NWS summary covers the October 9–10, 2026 event and lists observed gusts up to 118 mph and a highest reported rainfall total of 11.65 inches. It reports one direct and two indirect fatalities as preliminary; extreme-wind and storm-surge assessments remained ongoing. The report cautions point observations may not capture peak values.
review_question: Can a time-sensitive relay keep the observation location, report date, preliminary status, and ongoing assessment attached?
